method: Cupertino first, then the 10-15 mile ring. Every field below was transcribed from a page actually retrieved this turn (URL in the row). Nothing was typed from memory. Candidates whose street address or weekly hours could not be pinned to a citable page were put in `rejected` with the URL that shows why, rather than merged with a guess. Yelp business pages return HTTP 403 to direct fetch in this environment, so Yelp facts are recorded from the Yelp business-page URL as surfaced by search, and are levelled 'listing'/'conflicting', never 'official'.
